thread:
mike: Heads up — planning an orchestrated edge policy swap for EU + APAC tonight 22:00 UTC. This is a non-incident rollout but we want hands on deck for the quiet window. Who can own the change and rollback?

sara: I can own APAC primary. I’ll be available 21:30–23:30 UTC.

kiran: I’ll take EU primary. Will run the route change and smoke.

lee: I’ll monitor dashboards and take alerts for any spike. Post any metric thresholds you want me to watch.

mike: Plan summary:
- 22:00 UTC: start staged policy update.
- 22:00–22:06: bump steer to 10% (verify), hold 6m.
- 22:06–22:12: bump to 50%, hold 6m.
- 22:12–22:20: bump to 100% finalize.
Fallback: immediate rollback to previous policy if p95 latency increases >200ms or error rate >0.5%.

sara: ACK for APAC. What are the exact commands?

mike: Use infractl for the live change — example:

```
# APAC step
infractl traffic update --region apac --policy edge-steer --weight 10 --reason "canary-step-1"
# EU step
infractl traffic update --region eu --policy edge-steer --weight 10 --reason "canary-step-1"
```

And to rollback if needed:
```
infractl traffic update --region <region> --policy edge-steer --weight 0 --reason "rollback"
```

kiran: For EU I'll run the infractl commands and also toggle the route-proxy flag so we get route-level logging. Smoke checklist I’ll run after each step:
- curl -sSf https://eu.example.com/healthz (expect 200)
- curl -sSf https://eu.example.com/ping (latency < 150ms)
- check logs for 5xx spikes: `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=edge-proxy --since=5m | grep 5xx`

lee: I’ll watch these dashboards: edge-requests (p50/p95), 5xx-rate, origin-error-rate, and redis cache miss ratio. I’ll post if anything crosses thresholds.

mike: ops-bot will kick off alerts to the paging list on threshold; deploy-bot will confirm the infractl ops were recorded.

ops-bot: FYI — quiet window policy enabled at 21:45–23:45 UTC. Ensure any unrelated deploys are blocked. :warning:

deploy-bot: Scheduled change recorded: change_id=chg_20260320_001, owners={kiran,sara}, window=22:00-22:20UTC.

sara: Quick preflight checks — all infractl clients are on v1.12. If anyone is on older CLI the command may fail. Run `infractl --version`.

mike: confirmed infractl v1.12 on my machine. kiran/sara — please paste a quick success when you hit each step so we have an audit trail.

kiran: Step 1 (10%) applied for EU at 22:00:12 UTC. Health checks passing, p95 120ms, no 5xx.
sara: Step 1 for APAC applied at 22:00:18 UTC. Health green.

lee: Observability note — small spike in 50–60ms on p50 during APAC step 1, expected. No errors.

mike: Proceed to 50% after 6m unless anyone calls hold.

kiran: Moving to 50% for EU in 30s.

kiran: EU step 2 (50%) applied at 22:06:55 UTC — basic checks OK, minor tail latency bump but below threshold.
sara: APAC 50% applied at 22:07:05 UTC, checks OK.

lee: Watching for sustained p95 >200ms — nothing yet. If that happens I’ll call rollback and ping both owners.

mike: Final bump to 100% at 22:12 after the 6m hold. If anything goes sideways rollback command is above.

kiran: Final 100% EU done at 22:12:30 UTC. All clear.
sara: Final 100% APAC done at 22:12:40 UTC. No errors, metrics stable.

mike: Great work — can we keep the quiet window and monitoring for another 30m? Then we’ll close out the thread and update the runbook.

lee: Staying on watch until 22:45 UTC. Will post a final status.

mike: After-action items:
- kiran/sara: add exact infractl audit IDs to the change ticket.
- ops: add short note to runbook about the staged timings and rollback thresholds.
- devex: circulate a short postmortem template in case any regressions show up.

deploy-bot: change_id=chg_20260320_001 closed at 22:40:11 UTC (status: success).

lee: Final — no post-rollout regressions observed through watch window. Closing thread at 22:45 UTC. :tada:

mike: Thanks all — if anyone sees anything later tag the thread and we’ll reopen.
